summary: Diffable snapshots, a card grid with adaptive columns, a column-based table model, a source list and visible-row windowing exist as pure models. There are no SDK list or collection views with cells, reuse, selection modes, swipe actions, pull to refresh or drag and drop integration.
rea_evidence: not captured: tools/parity/rea-page.sh reported 'no CDP browser on 127.0.0.1:9333 (run: tools/parity/rea-page.sh --start)'; facts are from tools/parity/docc.py

features.note: adaptive columns from a minimum item width, an optional hero item and fixed-height rows; frames and hit testing only. No custom layout objects, no sections with supplementary views, no orthogonal scrolling sections
snapshot diff with inserts, deletes and moves; no section snapshots for hierarchical data
visible_rows computes a window with overscan; no reuse pool and no prefetch callbacks
Section and Form draw inset grouped rows; no cell classes, no accessories (disclosure, detail) and no content configuration objects
column model with sort descriptors, header clicks, resize and reorder, and a source list with sections; no touch row editing, no section index, no estimated heights

features.apple: allowsMultipleSelection, selection follows focus, two-finger pan multiselect
features.note: single selection with keyboard movement; no multi-select mode, no band selection
leading and trailing row actions revealed by a horizontal swipe. Needs the swipe recognizer and a row view; a common touch pattern
pull to refresh needs overscroll events from the scroll view (springboard/sdk/src/view/scroll.rs has the rubber band)

features.apple: moveRowAt, isEditing, insert and delete styles
features.note: reordering a row of icons by dragging; no table editing mode
session state machine exists; list integration (drop proposals, placeholders) does not
text measure is available; no self-sizing pass and no dynamic type
arrow-key focus to the nearest view in a direction
thumbnail service with caching; not tied to a cell lifecycle

gaps: SDK list and collection views with cell reuse, accessories and selection modes
Swipe actions and pull to refresh
Section snapshots and compositional layout sections
Drop proposals and placeholders for lists
Section index and editing mode for tables
